{{Top|leg}}
'''Carbonite poisoning''' was a side-effect of an improper [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|carbon-freezing]] process. While [[Hibernation sickness/Legends|hibernation sickness]] is an expected side-effect of being suspended in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] for a long time, imperfections during the process could poison the encased individual, who without medical assistance would eventually succumb to [[Death/Legends|death]]. [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]] contracted carbonite poisoning after being frozen in carbonite by the orders of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Arcann]], and survived only because [[Tenebrae|Valkorion]] used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to save the Commander's life.<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Carbonite poisoning appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion, released with Update 4.0.
